## Cohort flowchart

`fc_draw()` draws the STROBE cohort flow diagram from `patients_fc`, the flowchart object built step by step on the [Create cohort](create_cohort.qmd) page, so every box matches a step in the code. Before the diagram leaves the secure environment, every box is checked for counts from 1 to 10, including excluded counts that could be recovered by subtraction, under the data use agreement's small-cell rule (see [AGENTS.md](agents.qmd), "Restricted data"). The diagram is not yet exported to `figures/`.
